item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 15 October 2026(Thursday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Laguna (Siniloan, Pangil, Famy, Paete, Pakil, Kalayaan, Lumban, Luisiana, Cavinti, Nagcarlan, Liliw, Magdalena, Majayjay, Pagsanjan, Rizal, Santa Cruz, Pila, Victoria, San Pablo, Calauan, Mabitac, and Santa Maria) and Quezon (Panukulan, Burdeos, Polillo, Patnanungan, Jomalig, Real, Mauban, Atimonan, Infanta, Tayabas, Sampaloc, Lucban, Pagbilao, Lucena, Candelaria, Sariaya, Dolores, Tiaong, San Antonio, Padre Burgos, and General Nakar) within the next 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
